protocol: UVD-1 portable execution v1; preserved inference policy
candidate_policy: single highest-scoring class per proposal (DetectionPredictor multi_label=False); differs from multi-label training validation
selection: all official validation images as exposed development
interpretation: Established full-frame/fixed slicing controls; not exact SAHI-author reproduction or a novel algorithm
timing_boundary: JPEG read/decode through CPU output predictions; includes view construction, model preprocessing/inference/postprocessing, device transfers and CPU tile merge; artifact writing and metric calculation excluded
timing_limits: Cached filesystem and desktop hardware; one inference per image/method is a first sweep, not a repeated stable latency benchmark
